name: adv_junction_loop_closure_cycle
source:
// Union-find loop closure: connect(a,b), connect(b,c), connect(c,a) must
// collapse to ONE node, not three, and must not double-count the flow sum.
ThermalSource S1(T = 400)
Conduction    C1(k = 10, area = 1, L = 0.1)
Conduction    C2(k = 10, area = 1, L = 0.1)
ThermalSource S2(T = 300)
connect(S1.port, C1.a)
connect(C1.b, C2.a)
connect(C2.a, C1.b)
connect(C2.b, S2.port)
q1 = C1.Q
q2 = C2.Q
tm = C1.b.T

error.message: There are 18 equations and 17 variables. The problem is overspecified and cannot be solved. Redundant relation (no free variable left to determine): CONNECT c2.a, c1.b: sum(qdot) = 0. A common cause: the same physics stated twice — a boundary pinning a quantity a component already defines (a re-equated mixer pressure, a T-pinned wall state), or two property calls restating one relation.
